evidence.title: Website Section Design Inspiration Gallery | sectionmaster

name: sectionmaster
summary: Gallery of 460+ screenshot excerpts of real website sections — hero, navbar, pricing, footer — filterable by type and color.
description: Hand-picked website sections captured from real product and marketing sites. Each entry lists the source domain, its section type (navigation, hero, features, pricing, testimonials, team, cta, footer, faq, …) and the dominant color palette; the gallery filters by type and color, and signed-in users can save sections locally.
contains: 460 gallery examples of real website sections (site advertises 670+ sections)
section types: navigation, hero, features, pricing, testimonials, team, blog-list, cta, footer, contacts, faq and more
filters: section type and dominant color palette; search by site name or type
each entry shows the source domain and palette swatches; screenshots served from a CDN
saved sections stored in the browser; moodboards coming soon
